body: A bottle is set beside a fever note that says no bite was seen. The water-use line for the day has been crossed out, then copied back in.
title: Fever without a mark

cites.quote: Where I think he hid out

gloss: A fever report and changed water entry leave the source uncertain.
rival_reading: An evacuation or household illness could prompt the same water restriction; the note does not identify the fever’s source.
